ranked_findings.finding: Bulk refund requests accepted without idempotency keys caused duplicate refunds
evidence: timeline/incident_timeline.md: bulk refund requests accepted without idempotency keys at 10:17 UTC
tickets/TICKET-8729.md: every duplicate has request_class=bulk-refund and no idempotency key

ranked_findings.finding: Idempotency-required guardrail was bypassed due to legacy_batch_header
evidence: timeline/incident_timeline.md: idempotency-required guardrail skipped due to legacy_batch_header at 10:18 UTC

ranked_findings.finding: Bulk-refund endpoint must reject requests without idempotency keys and remove legacy_batch_header bypass
evidence: remediation/notes.md: bulk-refund requests must be rejected unless they include an idempotency key; remove the legacy_batch_header bypass before re-enabling the endpoint

unresolved_ambiguity: Worker replay was an early theory (TICKET-8721) opened before API gateway logs were available, but final evidence points to missing idempotency keys as the primary cause
